method: Independent source-only review of the diagnostics change. No tests, builds, browser or process launches, credential reads, or account changes were performed.

A_runtime.reason: Runtime admission and execution are owned by the root lane; this review makes no runtime claim.

observations: failureStage uses only fixed source literals; failureCategory is set from fixed literals or a fixed fallback. Raw caught exceptions and error messages are suppressed.
The diagnostics retain only URL origin plus pathname. URL query and hash are omitted; credentials and form values are never interpolated into evidence or diagnostics.
Credential-file failures expose only a fixed category selected from the error code; parsed credential values remain local to the login function.

The real UI flow remains intact: guest Settings assertions precede credential use, the actual web form must reach same-origin /dashboard, then the extension Settings Sign in control must yield admin email, role, sign-out, and advanced capabilities.

The web tab closes on login failure and in the extension-flow finally block on subsequent failure. The existing owned-profile harness remains responsible for spawned-Chrome and temporary-profile cleanup.
limits: This source review does not establish that the run succeeds or that a browser's actual redirect path is free of sensitive material; runtime remains pending.
